opening.argument: The promotion presents Forsage as a path toward financial freedom and passive income, while calling it a great opportunity and moving interested viewers into private contact channels. The description urges viewers not to miss passive-income opportunities and to send a direct message. WhatsApp and Telegram details provide a recruitment-style next step, but the material gives no explanation of material conditions, risks, or a verifiable basis for the proposed home-based income and financial outcome.
